welcome.title: Your Fitbit, scored every morning
welcome.subtitle: Sleep, Recovery and Strain from Health Connect, worked out on this phone.
welcome.private: Stays on this phone. No account, no server.
welcome.sampleFailed: Couldn’t build the sample data. Try again.

profile.title: Two things Health Connect doesn’t share
profile.intro: Pulse compares your heart rate with people of your age, using the reference ranges you choose. You can change these later in Settings.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Shown on Home and in Settings. Stays on this phone.
form.birthDateHint: For heart rate zones, sleep need and Pulse Age.
form.rangesHint: Strain, sleep targets, VO2 max and Pulse Age use male and female reference tables. Choose the one closer to your body today; on long-term hormone therapy, that is usually the one that matches your hormones.
form.timeZoneHint: Where you live. Your days start at midnight here.
form.heightHint: Adds lean body mass to Pulse Age.
form.maxHrHint: Leave blank to estimate it from your age.

connect.unavailable: Health Connect isn’t available on this phone.
connect.updateRequired: Health Connect needs an update. Open it, update it, then come back.
connect.openFailed: Couldn’t open Health Connect. Try again.
connect.waitingBody: Choose what Pulse can read in Health Connect’s window. You come back here when you’re done.
connect.refusedBody: Pulse needs at least heart rate and sleep. Allow every permission, including access to older data.
connect.title: What Pulse reads
connect.intro: From Health Connect, kept on this phone. The first import reads the last 180 days.
connect.introSample: From Health Connect, kept on this phone. The first import reads the last 180 days. Your sample data is cleared once you connect.
connect.readFood: Food and water you log in Fitbit
connect.readBody: Weight, body fat and VO2 max

importing.title: Importing your data
importing.bodySample: Half a year of a demo person’s days, scored on this phone.
importing.body: Up to 180 days from Health Connect, scored on this phone. The first import takes a few minutes.

background.title: Keep Pulse up to date
background.bodyOn: Pulse syncs while it’s closed. Change it in Settings › Notifications & background.
background.bodyBattery: One more step: under Battery, choose Allow background activity or Unrestricted. Many phones pause Pulse in the background otherwise.
background.body: Sync while Pulse is closed. Many phones also need Pulse allowed to run in the background; the button opens that setting.
